name: Amanah Sunnah API
description:
The most comprehensive Islamic knowledge API following the methodology of Ahlus Sunnah wal Jamaah (Salaf).

## Data Coverage
- **6,236** Quran verses with Tafsir Ibn Kathir
- **36,390** Hadith from 7 major collections (Kutub Sittah + Muwatta Malik)
- **18,298** Narrators from Taqrib At-Tahdzib
- **66** Chapters of Kitab At-Tawhid
- **97** Daily Sunnah practices
- **50** Duas from authentic hadith
- **99** Asmaul Husna (Names of Allah)
- **42** Hadith Nawawi

## Features
- Hybrid semantic search (pgvector + BM25)
- AI-powered Q&A with RAG from 67,458+ verified references
- Kajian webhook for YouTube video transcription & AI summarization
- Hadith grading from Shaykh Al-Albani, Ahmad Shakir, Zubair Ali Zai

## Authentication
All endpoints require an API key via X-API-Key header.
Get your free key at [Developer Portal](https://sunnah.amanahagent.cloud/developers).

## Rate Limits
- **60 requests/minute**
- **10,000 requests/day**

Completely free. No paid tiers. API key is for identification and abuse prevention only.
Exceeding limits returns 429 Too Many Requests.

## Methodology
All data follows the understanding of the Salafus Shalih. No AI-generated content in the knowledge base. Hadith grading from recognized muhaddithin only.
